calls.video_title: Zeta Global Stock: Buy, Hold, or Sell in October 2026?
calls.thesis: BUY reiterated (ranking updated 9 Oct 2026, previously updated 7 Aug 2026; held as buying opportunity all year): fairly valued at 28x forward P/E and DCF $33.70 vs $33.54, but FCF estimates keep being revised higher; revenue $300M (2021 TTM) to $1.57B TTM, CFO/sales 7% to 15.3%, R&D/revenue down to 9.36%, stock up 65%+ YTD; medium conviction.
calls.base_case: DCF fair value $33.70 vs $33.54 market = fairly valued; forward P/E 28 is mid-range (10 in 2025 to 55 in 2024) and near highest since Jan 2025.
calls.bull_case: AI-driven product gains (custom app build time from ~1 week to minutes) and repeated upward FCF revisions as business outperforms in 2026.
calls.bear_case: Risk noted generically — no specific bear case stated; valuation no longer cheap after 65%+ YTD run, so little margin of safety at fair value.
